text:
Pierre Sage has been sacked as Crystal Palace’s manager after 16 games. The Frenchman, appointed in mid-June to replace Oliver Glasner, has gone after Sunday’s 3-1 defeat by Liverpool left his team bottom of the Premier League.
Thomas Frank, out of work since his dismissal by Spurs in February, has emerged as the main candidate to succeed Sage. He spoke to Palace in the summer and is said to be keen for a new challenge after a successful spell at Brentford.
Sunday’s defeat was Palace’s fifth in an eight-match run which also included a painful 5-0 hammering by their arch-rivals Brighton. Their only victory in the sequence came in the Carabao Cup at Fulham and they have lost four league fixtures in a row.
Palace have seven points from 10 games, their league victories having come against Fulham and Nottingham Forest, and have conceded the most goals in the division: 24. They have been juggling domestic matches with the Europa League, where they sit 21st in the 36-team table.
“The club would like to place on record its thanks to Pierre and his staff for their efforts during their time in South London, and wish them well for the future,” Palace said in a statement.
Sage signed a three-year contract after leaving Lens, where he won the Coupe de France and qualified for the Champions League in his final season.
Alternatives to Frank include the former Nottingham Forest manager Sean Dyche, who also has his backers at Palace, and Vítor Pereira, another former Forest manager.
Palace have lost their two main central defenders this year, Marc Guéhi moving to Manchester City in January and Maxence Lacroix to Chelsea in the summer. Two loans players – Axel Disasi and the teenager Honest Ahanor – were signed as replacements. Palace did not land one of Sage’s top targets, winger Malick Fofana.
Sage is understood to have fallen out with the board over their failure to sign what he regarded as adequate replacements for Guéhi and Lacroix. The Palace chair, Steve Parish, was unhappy with Sage’s treatment of Jaydee Canvot, another centre-back, after the France Under-21 international was dropped from the squad for September’s home defeat by Ipswich, and expressed displeasure after Adam Wharton was substituted in that match.
digest_he:
קריסטל פאלאס אישרה את פיטוריו של המאמן פייר סאג', שנכנס לתפקידו בחודש יוני במקומו של אוליבר גלזנר. הפיטורים מגיעים בעקבות תבוסה ביתית 3-1 לליברפול שהותירה את הקבוצה במקום האחרון בפרמייר ליג, עם מאזן של שבע נקודות בלבד מעשרה משחקים והגנה שספגה 24 שערים, הגרוע בליגה.

תומאס פרנק, שאימן בעבר את ברנטפורד וטוטנהאם ומאז פברואר ללא קבוצה, מסתמן כמועמד העיקרי של ההנהלה להחליפו. בתקופת כהונתו הקצרה של סאג' התגלו חיכוכים רבים בינו לבין ההנהלה בנוגע למדיניות הרכש וחיזוק הסגל, לאחר עזיבתם של שחקני מפתח דוגמת מארק גואהי ומקסנס לאקרואה. המועדון שוקל מועמדים נוספים, בהם שון דייץ ווויטור פריירה, במטרה לשקם את הקבוצה בזירה המקומית והאירופית.
